# Synthetic research fixture

This document contains synthetic release-verification material, not measured scientific results.

## Study plan

The proposed experiment compares a local document-retrieval baseline with a bounded draft, critique and revision workflow. Primary outcomes are source coverage, invalid source identifiers, elapsed time and requested output tokens. A source identifier proves that an excerpt is present in the selected corpus; it does not prove a scientific claim is true.

## Privacy and limitations

Offline evidence maps use no model or external service. Optional model runs send the selected question and retrieved excerpts only to the configured endpoint. There is no automatic cloud fallback. Reports are saved to encrypted local notes only when the user requests retention. Exported Markdown and JSON files are plaintext.

## Next validation step

Use separate held-out tasks, compare both conditions with the same corpus, record failures as well as successes, and publish the protocol before reporting comparative performance. Do not describe this synthetic fixture as a benchmark result.
